question: Which state is set to become the overall champion of the Khelo India Youth Games 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Khelo India Youth Games 2025 to conclude with colourful ceremony in Patna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The games started on **4th May 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
It will be held at **Pataliputra Sports Complex**, **Kankarbagh**, **Patna, Bihar**.

 
 
• 
 
**Maharashtra** is the **overall champion**.

 
 
• 
 
158 medals (58 gold, 47 silver, and 53 bronze)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Haryana** finished in **second place**.

 
 
• 
 
117 medals

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Rajasthan** came in **third place**.

 
 
• 
 
60 medals

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The closing ceremony will have **colorful performances** and **entertainment**.
